{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Diamond Domain |image=Diamond Domain.png |imagesize=300px |characters=ダイヤモンド鉱国 |japanese=Diamond Ore Country |region=Kalos |epicode=M17 |episode=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction }} The '''Diamond Domain''' (Japanese: '''ダイヤモンド鉱国''' ''Diamond Ore Country'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is one of the settings of ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]''. It neighbors the [[Allearth Forest]]. It is a beautiful, underground domain where many {{p|Carbink}} live in peace and {{an|Diancie}} serves as its ruler. Among these many Carbink, [[Carbink servants|four are named]], and have a close association with Diancie. The '''Heart Diamond''' (Japanese: '''せいなるダイヤ''' ''Holy Diamond'') is a large diamond created by Diancie, which is used to sustain the land and provide the Diamond Domain with energy and tranquility. One day, the Heart Diamond was on the verge of losing its energy due to its old age. According to Dace, an elderly and wise Carbink, should the power of the Heart Diamond die out, the Diamond Domain would be finished. As such, it gave Diancie the task of creating a new Heart Diamond, as only she had the ability do so. However, she failed to complete this task, lacking the power needed to create a new one. Due to this, Dace now tasked Diancie with finding {{p|Xerneas}}, whose {{a|Fairy Aura}} would be give Diancie the power she needed to be able to create a Heart Diamond. Diancie and her [[Carbink servants]] then left the Diamond Domain to fulfill this task. Later, Diancie and the Carbink servants returned to the Diamond Domain together with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, partially to seek shelter from thieves hunting down Diancie. During the time Diancie had been away, the Diamond Domain had begun falling into despair, as the Heart Diamond was now completely dead. After this, Ash, his friends, Diancie and the Carbink servants left the Diamond Domain again to journey to the nearby Allearth Forest, this time accompanied by Dace, as Diancie sensed Xerneas's aura coming from here. After Xerneas had driven off Yveltal inside Allearth Forest and returned the balance of nature, the group, Diancie and the Carbink servants returned to the Diamond Domain once more. Diancie used her newfound power from Mega Evolution to create a new Heart Diamond that would be able to sustain the Diamond Domain with new energy and tranquility for years to come. ==Pokémon== {| width="50%" | {{InactivePoké|Diamond Domain|Diancie|Diancie anime.png|Rock|Fairy|size=250px|link=Diancie (Pokémon)}} [[File:Mega Evolution key stone icon.png|20px|link=Mega Evolution]] | {{InactivePoké|Diamond Domain|Carbink|Diamond Domain Carbink.png|Rock|Fairy|size=250px|disp=Carbink (multiple)|link=Carbink (Pokémon)}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Diamond Domain M17 manga.png|thumb|220px|The Diamond Domain in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== The Diamond Domain appeared in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}''. {{sectionstub}} {{-}} ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | ''Diamond Domain'' {{langtable|color={{colorschemelight|XY}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|XY}} |zh_yue=鑽石礦國 ''Jyunsehk Kwonggwok'' |zh_cmn=鑽石礦國 / 钻石矿国 ''Zuànshí Kuàngguó'' |da=Diamant Domæne |de=Diamantenreich |fi=Timanttivaltakunta |fr_eu=Royaume des Diamants |it=Regno dei diamanti |ko=다이아몬드 광산국 ''Diamond Gwangsanguk'' |nl=Diamantrijk |no=Diamant-riket |pl=Diamentowe Królestwo |pt=Domínio do Diamante |ru=Королевство Алмазов ''Korolevstvo Almazov'' |es_la=Dominio de los Diamantes |es_eu=Reino de los Diamantes |sv=Diamantdomänen }} | ''Heart Diamond'' {{langtable|color={{colorschemelight|XY}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|XY}} |ja=せいなるダイヤ |zh_yue=神聖的鑽石 ''Sàhnsing dīk Jyunsehk'' {{tt|*|Movie}}
